Gauṇamukhya
text on pradhāna an. upasarjana. Ref. to in Kāśikā IV. 3. 88.

Gauṇḍalī(goṇḍalī_?)nṛtyakathana
from Sahyādrikhaṇḍa of Skandapurāṇa. BISM. thi 468. Goṇḍalī is a form of dance described by Someśvara, Śārṅgadeva Jāyasenāpati etc. For a detailed account of it, see V. Raghavan, Intro. to Nṛttaratnāvalī of last writer, p.. 134-141.
